fieldValues.title: Clusters cannot be compared side by side
fieldValues.statement: A cluster only means something next to the other clusters of its domain: clusters are relative. Too many clusters, or clusters that overlap, become meaningless, and nobody can tell that from one cluster at a time. The owner cannot see a domain's clusters together with the problems inside each, so cannot judge how they differ before affirming or reshaping them.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-16: affirming the Agent memory clusters in the Method editor
